name: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Protection Potion
summary: A transferable writ requests one Shadow Protection Potion and gives details for delivery and payment. The transaction depends on bringing the writ with you.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A faded note asks you to provide one Shadow Protection Potion. It also gives the delivery place and payment details, and says the writ can pass from hand to hand. You need the writ with you to complete the exchange.

faq.answer: The writ requests one Shadow Protection Potion.
The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Does the writ say how I will be paid?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need to keep the writ with me?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ with you to complete the transaction.
